title: Orders and what you can order
summary: What arrives in Supermarket Simulator starts as an order: the game models orders and keeps each product as its own object with an id, so the order list is built out of things the shop has unlocked.
body: An order is a modelled thing in the game with its own order data, which is why ordering is a step you take rather than a shelf that refills itself.
Products are stored as their own objects with identifiers, so each product can be ordered, priced and sold as a distinct line.
Because identifiers keep growing as the catalogue does, the shop can add products over time without reusing an old line.
What this entry does not tell you: order sizes, delivery times or the price of any product. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Orders and their data are modelled by the game.
Products exist as their own objects rather than as text rows.
Product identifiers are allocated rather than fixed by name.
Boxes carry a market price of their own.
The build ships the paper bag an online order is packed into, along with its own indicator and a notebook paper material.
An online delivery is drawn on the shop's own map, with a pin texture for it and one for the customer's own delivery.
facts.evidence: asset names: T_Mappins_OnlineDelivery, T_Customer_OnlineDelivery, SM_Deliverytag, SM_Deliverytagrope

facts.claim: The paper bag has further pieces of its own: an opened version and a second version, with a decal and a set of lines.
facts.evidence: asset names: SM_PaperBagOpened, SM_PaperBagv2, M_PaperBag_Decal, M_PaperBag_Lines

facts.claim: The paper bag side also names a bag for the checkout and an indicator for the bag an online order goes into, with a separate bag set that has its own suffix variants.
facts.evidence: asset names: PaperBagCheckout, Online Order Paper Bag Indicator, Bag_s45li3, Bag_s45li3_a, Bag_s45li3_m

facts.claim: Online orders are a setting and a set of pieces of their own: an enable flag, a toggle, a key entry for it, an order name, a notification and a customer indicator for an online order.
facts.evidence: asset names: EnableOnlineOrder, EnableOnlineOrderToggle, KeybindEntry_OnlineOrder, OrderName, Online_Order_Notif, Online Order Customer Indicator
